source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of finally and else (PDF 61).

blocks.text: finally block hamesha chalta hai, exception (ghalti) aaye ya na aaye. else block (agar likha ho) sirf tab chalta hai jab try mein koi ghalti na aaye. Is se kuch code har haal mein chalaya ja sakta hai, aur ghalti na hone par alag kaam kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"try :": poora khatre wala kaam try ke andar hai.
"number = int(input("Enter a number"))": user se number leta hai; prompt ke aakhir mein space ya colon nahi, is liye jo likha jaye woh "Enter a number" ke saath chipka nazar aata hai. Word likhne par int() ValueError deta hai.
"result = 10 / number": 0 likhne par ZeroDivisionError.
"except ZeroDivisionError:": 0 wali ghalti pakar kar "You can’t divide by zero ! " print karta hai (kitab ki spacing aur tirchhe apostrophe ke saath).
"except ValueError:": number ki jagah text likhne wali ghalti pakar kar "Invalid input! Please enter a valid number." print karta hai.
"else :": sirf tab chalta hai jab try mein koi ghalti na aaye: "The result is" ke saath jawab.
"finally :": har haal mein chalta hai: "Execution completed.".
Output: 4 likhne par "The result is 2.5" aur "Execution completed."; 0 likhne par zero wala message aur "Execution completed."; "abc" likhne par "Invalid input! Please enter a valid number." aur "Execution completed.".

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yeh code bikhra hua chhapa hai: kai lines ke tukre alag alag columns mein hain (maslan "Ent er a", "number" aur ""))" alag, "f inally" toota hua). Oopar tukron ko sahi order mein jor kar code diya gaya hai.
Yani else sirf ghalti na hone par chal kar division ka result dikhata hai, aur finally har haal mein aakhri message print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: User abc likhe to kya print hota hai?
blocks.explanation: "Invalid input! Please enter a valid number." aur phir "Execution completed."

blocks.text: number_text woh text hai jo user likhta. Isay "5", "0" ya koi word likh kar Run karein aur dekhein kab except, kab else chalta hai; finally har baar chalta hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"number_text = "4"": woh text jo user likhta; abhi yeh "4" hai.
"number = int(number_text)": text ko number mein badalta hai; text number na ho to ValueError.
"result = 10 / number": 10 / 4 = 2.5; number 0 ho to ZeroDivisionError.
"except ZeroDivisionError:" aur "except ValueError:": dono ghaltiyon ke apne apne message.
"else:": koi ghalti na ho to "The result is 2.5" print hota hai.
"finally:": har haal mein "Execution completed." print hota hai.
Output: "The result is 2.5" aur "Execution completed.".
Khud try karein: number_text = "0" kar ke Run karein: "You can't divide by zero!" aur "Execution completed." aayega; "abc" par "Invalid input! Please enter a valid number." aur phir "Execution completed.".

items: else: ghalti na ho to; finally: hamesha.
Kai except blocks alag ghaltiyan sambhalte hain.
